what: Year-keyed statutory config for the EPF calculation. Periods are wage months, inclusive, not payment dates. The report docs/research/epf.md explains each rule and its evidence.

shared.nilNote: Liability test on actual wages (KWSP employer FAQ Q18, Q25). Applied before the floor by inference. Parts A to E print a NIL row; Part F does not, so for Part F this rests on the general FAQ.
shared.contributionMonth: Wage month + 1. Payment is due by the 15th of the contribution month.

F.wageCapNote: Part F para 3 lets the Board prescribe a limit. KWSP's page shows 'No limit'. Keep the field.

roundingEvidence.perShare: KWSP non-Malaysian FAQ, Employer Q23 and Employee Q24 (captures 2025-10-03 to 2026-10-20): RM1,751 gives RM36 + RM36 = RM72.
roundingEvidence.total: KWSP mandatory-contribution page, Example 2.4 (captures 2026-01-06 and 2026-08-10): RM6,710 gives RM268.40, rounded to RM269; the split is not stated.
roundingEvidence.statute: Part F para 2: 'The total contribution which includes cents shall be rounded to the next ringgit.'

F.alsoStops: Two months before a work pass expires with no extension (s.70G; KWSP employer FAQ Q27).
F.excludes: Domestic servants (mandatory contribution). They may elect.

above20000.provisionalSplit: employee = ceil(wage x employee rate); employer = total - employee
above20000.splitStatus: KWSP does not state the split; RM1 uncertainty until its calculator is run.

bonusNote.employer: ceil(wage x employerUpTo5000) on actual wages
bonusNote.employee: table on total wages at or below RM20,000; exact rate above
bonusNote.above20000: Note still applies to the whole month (recommended reading, unverified)

ageBoundaries.basis: KWSP calculator getAge (cached 2022-07-04 and 2026-04-09) treats the birth month as still the old age. Server logic not seen and no written KWSP rule found. Two uncited blogs say the same for age 60. Nothing names a month for age 75.
ageBoundaries.statute: Third Schedule 'attain the age of sixty years'; Act 452 First Schedule para (13); s.50(2B)(a).

accountSplit.nonMalaysian: Same structure (restructuring FAQ Q7, Q8). The percentages for non-Malaysians are inferred, medium-high.

topUp.name: i-Topup
topUp.calculatorLimits: Percentage up to 100%; amount up to total wages.

methodEvidence.tablePlusWholeRinggit: Act 452 s.43(3) ('by one ringgit or a multiple of one ringgit'); KWSP 2022 page under-60 rows.
methodEvidence.combinedRateOnActualWage: KWSP i-Topup pages, captures 2026-01-09 and 2026-10-23. Internally inconsistent: unchanged share uses the table in some rows and exact 12% in one.

shared.reducedRateNote: None in 2025 or 2026. The last reductions ended with June 2022 wages (P.U.(A) 467/2021).

minimumWageFloor.law: Act 452 s.43(1A), as quoted on KWSP pages
minimumWageFloor.appliesTo: Every employee and employer subject to a Minimum Wages Order, on the applicable Part. Not domestic servants. Apprentices only from 2025-08 wages (inference).
minimumWageFloor.use: base = max(epfWage, floor), then look up the band or percentage. Compute the floor in sen and do not round it to a band first.

formula.monthlyPartMonth: monthly rate x daysEligible / daysInWagePeriod (Employment Act s.18A divisor proposed; KWSP gives none)
formula.daily: daily rate for the employee's days per week x days worked

smallEmployer.appliesWhen: Fewer than 5 employees and not a MASCO professional activity

periods.note: That the small-employer rate also defers the EPF floor is a statutory reading; no KWSP statement found.

periods.status: confirmed to 2026-12; carried forward after that

exemptMsmeBelowRm50mSales.basis: Assumed. Reports call the exemption temporary; what exempt firms pay is not stated.

periods.note: Day in June and exemption period unconfirmed. Do not ship the derived RM10.26/hour as a rate. The RM2,500 semi-skilled and graduate minimum has no instrument and is not a floor.

voluntary.capFromSource: Deputy Finance Minister in the Dewan Rakyat, via an MOF press clipping of a Bernama report (single source; no KWSP notice found).

matchSchemes.note: Voluntary and outside payroll. No effect on salaried take-home. A member gets only one of i-Saraan or i-Saraan Plus in a year.

iSaraanPlus.condition: Contributions made through the e-hailing or p-hailing service provider.

dividends.note: Not re-checked in the deep pass. Projections only.

government.note: EPF follows appointment status, not sector. No separate government rate exists in the sources found.

govContract.label: Contract, including federal interim contracts from 2024-02-01
govContract.parts: A or E; C for PR; B/D then F for non-citizens
govContract.option: retireeOptOut: rehired citizen pensioners aged 55+ may choose not to contribute (UP.1.1.1 para 64; KWSP FAQ Q22(h) lists them as liable, unreconciled)

govEpfOption.label: Permanent officer who chose the s.6A EPF scheme

govPensionPrePTB.label: Permanent, on the pension track, before pension status is granted

government.notModelled: KWAP 17.5% (employer-only) and contract gratuity. Neither affects monthly take-home.

govContributoryPermanent.note: First interim contracts end around 2027-01-31. Keep govContract as default until a circular or Act amendment appears.

periods.source: KWSP Third Schedule, 'Effective 1 July 2022 to 30 September 2025'
KWSP Third Schedule, 'Effective 1 October 2025'; Act A1760 ss.1(2), 10, 11; P.U.(B) 354/2025 (number from Skrine, gazette text not seen)

2026.status: confirmed to the newest capture (2026-10-24 to 26); no change found

periods.source: KWSP Third Schedule, 'Effective 1 October 2025'; KWSP employer page captured 2026-08-10
Carried forward. Budget 2027 announces no contribution-rate change.

periods.changes: Minimum-wage floor period only (see minimumWageFloor). Not gazetted.

2027.matchSchemesUnconfirmed: Keep i-Saraan RM500/RM5,000, i-Suri RM300/RM3,000 and i-Saraan Plus RM600/RM6,000. The Budget 2027 annex groups all three under 'up to RM600 / RM6,000', which conflicts with the speech and with KWSP's i-Saraan page of 2026-10-23.
2027.watch: MOF said in Oct 2026 that the 2% foreign-worker rate is relatively low. KWSP says it is subject to revision. No change announced.
